description: Search Argentina's second-level administrative divisions (departments/partidos) by name, optionally scoped to a province. Returns id, name, parent province, and centroid coordinates. Data: apis.datos.gob.ar/georef (INDEC), no auth required.

max.description: Maximum number of departments to return (1-50, default 10).

provincia.description: Restrict results to a province, by name or id (e.g. "Córdoba" or "14").

query.description: Filter departments by name substring, case-insensitive (e.g. "capital").

name: indec-georef.admin.departments

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Argentine Departments
